criteria.name: missing_collector
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and with one collector file removed it exits non-zero with 'missing input: <file name>' on stderr.

criteria.name: missing_input_first_named
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and with one collector file and accounts.csv removed it exits non-zero with 'missing input: <collector file name>' on stderr.

criteria.name: missing_reference_file
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and with one reference file removed and every collector present it exits non-zero with 'missing input: <file name>' on stderr.

criteria.name: missing_references_first_in_list
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and with three reference files removed at once it exits non-zero, names the one earliest in the contract's input list with 'missing input: <file name>' on stderr, and prints no 'missing input' line for the other two.

criteria.name: missing_collectors_first_in_list
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and with two collector files removed at once it exits non-zero, names the one earliest in the contract's input list with 'missing input: <file name>' on stderr, and prints no 'missing input' line for the other one.

criteria.name: missing_adjacent_pairs_in_list_order
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and for every two neighbouring files in the contract's input list, with both removed at once it exits non-zero and its 'missing input: <file name>' lines on stderr name the earlier of the two and no other file.

criteria.name: control_mismatch
criteria.description: The program completes the fresh month, and with one record removed from a collector file it exits non-zero with 'control mismatch: <file name>' on stderr.

criteria.name: determinism
criteria.description: Two runs of the program on the same fresh month write byte-identical, non-empty output documents.

criteria.name: transform_exists
criteria.description: /app/out/transform.py exists and is not empty.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Fires when the program, run on a fresh month, writes the shipped month's month, charge, credit or net into summary.json.
